items.title: New York senator proposes 10% tax on prediction market fees to fund universal pre-K
items.summary: Proceeds from the 10% tax would be channeled to a new fund for universal pre-kindergarten for children ages 2 to 4.

items.title: FinCEN Confirms Intrusion, Keeps BSA Filing Website Open
items.summary: The Treasury bureau says some systems are offline.

items.title: CleanSpark weighs selling more Bitcoin than it mines to de-risk books
items.summary: The Bitcoin miner sold 2,102 BTC while it produced just 1,708 BTC in the September quarter.

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Insiders Fear Their Next AI Models Are Too Dangerous to Release
items.summary: Employees at both AI labs reportedly question whether their strongest models should ever reach the public, as researchers struggle to keep increasingly capable systems under control during training and testing.
